intervention: reader_only: reopen the same complete immutable base and saved candidate bundles from each original repeat; do not refit controls, regenerate patches, change masks, cameras, sampling or scales.
paired_policy: Sixty fresh observed-support-axis readouts individually paired with all sixty frozen metric readouts. Each new readout repeat runs in a fresh subprocess. Native added-curve geometry must be byte-value identical to the paired normal record and is separately rescored without readout clipping.
qualification: Previously seen local fixture development evidence for a predeclared observed-support-axis task only; not blind evaluation. No general rod/plane/parallel-member/topology discrimination, independent object or G1 qualification. The reader retains unique actual points and selects axes by observed axial support rather than voxel representative means or raw point counts. Empty, unresolved, noisy and gap errors remain in the complete table.
